dataset_doi_note: The OSDR study metadata DOI fields were empty when retrieved. For the dataset citation, use the 'Citation' panel on the OSDR study page.
license_status: No license is stated in the OSD-575 study metadata. OSDR terms page: 'These data are provided under NASA's open access policy' and 'Users are responsible for knowing their rights to distribute information.' NASA's CC0 default (science.data.nasa.gov/about/license) applies to 'NASA-led mission data'; Inspiration4 was a private mission, for which that page says 'the data are provided as is'. Redistribution rights are therefore not confirmed: this project downloads the file on demand and does not bundle it.
acknowledgment_suggested_by_osdr: Data are courtesy of the NASA Open Science Data Repository
known_discrepancies: The OSDR study description lists post-flight samples R+1, R+45 and R+82, but the CMP file also contains R+194 rows (76 rows). Both are shown as given; this project does not resolve the difference.
One subject/analyte/timepoint row is absent from the file (C002, BUN/CREATININE RATIO, R+82).
scope_note: Sparse serum clinical-chemistry panel (7 timepoints) for the four Inspiration4 crew. Not continuous wearable telemetry, not ISS or long-duration data, and not a representative astronaut population.
